correctness.rationale: The proof gives an explicit piecewise classification of normalized three-distance collisions for antipodal cycle landmarks, derives the exact translation separation, and proves an exact vertical-lift criterion for cylinders. Optimizing the separation gives floor(L/3), so n=2L >= 6m with L odd yields a three-vertex multiset-resolving set. The standard lower bound for connected non-path graphs makes the dimension exactly three. Finite exhaustive checks support, but do not replace, the general proof.

originality.rationale: Qualified to the best of our knowledge. Marcelo–Tolentino–Garciano–Buot (2025) prove multiset dimension three for n >= 8m+1 and explicitly leave the remaining cylindrical cases open. Searches of exact and synonymous multiset-dimension, m-resolving, ID-coloring, Cartesian-product, cylindrical, congruence, and antipodal formulations, together with the current survey context and direct reference chain, found no prior theorem covering n >= 6m with n congruent to 2 modulo 4 or the exact antipodal-capacity formula. Residual risk remains from differently indexed or unindexed parallel work.

value.rationale: The theorem resolves an infinite, linearly wide portion of an explicit open parameter region, lowering the sufficient circumference coefficient from 8 to 6 on a full congruence class. The exact normalized-code collision mechanism also gives a reusable structural explanation and a sharp capacity statement for the antipodal boundary landmark family.
